tips.move: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. Walk to the street in front of home.
tips.swing: A zombie is close. Left click or Space swings your bat. Hit and step back; do not stand in reach.
tips.gate_repair: The home gate is damaged. Stand at it and hold R to repair it with materials.
tips.gate_open: The gate is sound. Press E beside it to open it, and E again to close it behind you.
tips.reclaim: Clear the zombies from a neighbouring yard, then press E at its porch to search and reclaim it.
tips.carry: Someone is down. Hold E beside them to lift them. They cannot be lifted with a zombie close.
tips.carry_drop: Follow the dashed line to a ringed shelter and press E to put them down.
tips.rest: Someone is hurt. Stand at the home porch and press E to rest them. It costs food.
tips.orders: Your team fights on its own. Press 1 to have them follow you, 2 to hold, 3 to engage threats and 4 to guard home.
tips.timber: You are beside a yard you hold. Press Q to strip its timber for materials; each yard gives it once.
tips.pistol: You have a pistol. Right click shoots where you aim. Shots are loud and every bullet is crafted, so save them for what a bat cannot stop.
tips.noise: Gunshots and engines are loud and pull zombies from far off, even ones that have not seen you. Keep them away from home and from anyone hurt.
tips.loadout: The workshop has armour and a shield ready. Press F, open Loadouts, and give them to a survivor who fights.
tips.field_bag: Someone is hurt and the field bag is unassigned. Press F, open Loadouts and give it to a survivor: they can then treat people in the field.
tips.van: Press E beside the van to drive it: W/S throttle, A/D steer. Followers close by ride along, a casualty in your arms comes too. Hold R beside it to start a repair that you or a survivor can finish. Park it near an exit and it comes with you.
tips.arrivals: Raiders are coming along the road from the entrance. Keep gates shut and fall back to home.
tips.work_board: Paid-for work waits on the work board. Press J to see it, put a survivor on each job and mark what comes first.
tips.area_office: The Office District. The Warden holds the service stair out, in the north-west. The bridge behind you leads back to the suburb, and a van is parked by home.
tips.area_industrial: The Industrial Works. The Foreman guards the main gate in the north-west: past it the road leaves town for good. The service road behind you leads back.
